title: Questions 161-163 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Marcus Reyes <m.reyes@northgatearchive.org>
From:Priya Nandakumar <p.nandakumar@northgatearchive.org>
Date:October 22
Subject:Annual Review
Attachment:Draft

Dear Marcus,

I am putting the finishing touches to the text of our annual review, which will be sent to our monthly supporters. As you are aware, the Northgate Archive Trust has converted more than 40,000 photographs from the county’s former mills into digital form this year. Although our organisation is modest in size compared with other regional trusts, we perform an essential function in preserving local history. Our supporters need to appreciate that.

For that reason, I want the review to feature this particular achievement so that people can see what their contributions make possible. As you handle our public relations, your feedback on the present version would be valuable to me. Would you look over the attached draft and tell me whether I have managed to get the key points across?

Best regards,

Priya
